# `Q-21-1` — Typst Not Found

> The `typst` binary could not be found on `PATH`, and `QUARTO_TYPST` is
> not set.

## What this means

Typst output is produced by rendering to Pandoc's own Typst writer and
then compiling the result to PDF with a real `typst` binary. Quarto
looked for `typst` on `PATH` and did not find it, and no `QUARTO_TYPST`
environment variable pointed at an explicit location.

## Why this happens

- Typst is not installed on this machine.
- Typst is installed but not on the shell's `PATH`.
- `QUARTO_TYPST` is set to a path that does not exist.

## How to fix

Install typst from [typst.app](https://typst.app), or — if it is already
installed somewhere not on `PATH` — set the `QUARTO_TYPST` environment
variable to the full path of the `typst` binary.

## Related errors

- [`Q-21-2`](Q-21-2.qmd) — typst was found, but its version is too old.
